verdict.rationale: Metronome exposes rate cards and contract-level overrides that let ops change subscription pricing (docs-6, docs-29) and apply per-customer overrides for trials/promotions (docs-27, docs-30), and it can surface a customer's historical tier changes (docs-28), which gives some building blocks for versioned pricing. However, docs-29 explicitly states that when a rate card price changes 'all contracts inherit the new pricing' at the next billing period — the opposite of automatic grandfathering — and there is no documented bulk cohort-migration tool or explicit grandfathering mechanism. Missing for 10: explicit grandfathering/versioned-plan feature that protects existing subscribers from a rate-card change, and a bulk/cohort migration tool for moving many customers to new pricing.
